# Google Calendar MCP Server

> A Model Context Protocol server that gives AI assistants like Claude Google Calendar integration for managing events, checking availability, and scheduling across multiple accounts and calendars.

Runs via npx, local installation, or Docker, and needs a Google Cloud project with the Calendar API enabled. With OAuth credentials you sign in once: through the `manage-accounts` tool or `npx @cocal/google-calendar-mcp auth` in stdio mode, or at the server URL in HTTP mode; a service account skips the sign-in entirely. Supports multi-account and multi-calendar queries, recurring events, free/busy checks, and natural language scheduling. OAuth tokens for an app in Google's test mode expire after 7 days unless the app is published or a service account is used.

## Docs

- [Google Calendar MCP Server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/README.md): MCP server integrating Google Calendar with AI assistants, with multi-account support, event management, and Cocal hosted alternative.
- [Documentation Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/docs/README.md): Index of getting started, user, deployment, development, and reference docs with quick links for users and developers.
- [Authentication Setup Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/docs/authentication.md): Step-by-step Google Cloud setup: creating a project, enabling the Calendar API, and configuring OAuth 2.0 credentials.
- [Advanced Usage Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/docs/advanced-usage.md): Multi-account usage, account parameter behavior per tool, calendar deduplication, batch operations, and smart scheduling.
- [Deployment Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/docs/deployment.md): Deploying via stdio or HTTP transport, server features, environment variables, and egress proxy configuration.
- [Development Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/docs/development.md): Development setup, contributing guidelines, and steps for adding new tools with handlers, schemas, and tests.
- [Architecture Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/docs/architecture.md): Transport modes, OAuth 2.0 authentication, handler architecture, and the full list of MCP calendar tools.
- [Testing Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/docs/testing.md): Running unit and integration tests, their requirements, and what each test category covers.
- [Multi-Account Concurrent Access Implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/MULTI_ACCOUNT_IMPLEMENTATION.md): Implementation plan for concurrent multi-account access, token management, and calendar deduplication with permission ranking.
- [Agent Guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/docs/agent-tool-usage.md): How AI agents should use the account parameter, detect accounts, and handle shared calendar deduplication.
- [Docker Deployment Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/docs/docker.md): Docker setup with stdio mode for Claude Desktop and localhost-only HTTP mode for development.
- [Multi-Account Updates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp/main/docs/multi-account-updates.md): Recent multi-account improvements: account discovery, safe token persistence, read/write awareness, and integration tests.
